canonical_state_rule: No adapter may create a second candidate, graph, context, approval, or evidence state model. Future execution projects immutable read-only results into the existing M6.3 CandidateBundle contract only.

adapters.permitted_future_use: derive deterministic route, issuer, period, form and source-policy filters before any local recall
adapters.blocking_gap: does not return versioned candidates, retrieval coordinates, index lineage or authority-normalized scores

adapters.permitted_future_use: pin an immutable local index snapshot and validate source/parser/index lineage before opening a future read-only adapter
adapters.blocking_gap: registry discovery is broad filesystem inventory, not a request-scoped CandidateBundle producer

adapters.permitted_future_use: future lexical recall against one explicitly registered SQLite FTS or immutable record snapshot
adapters.blocking_gap: index path, record snapshot digest, authority fields and coordinate lineage must be bound by a M6.3R adapter contract

adapters.permitted_future_use: future structured-object/table-context lexical recall against one registered immutable snapshot
adapters.blocking_gap: result rows need canonical source/parser/chunk/table/page/row provenance before they can enter M6.3

adapters.permitted_future_use: bounded relationship/neighbor recall from an explicitly pinned graph artifact and allowed universe
adapters.blocking_gap: current lookup is research-scope oriented; M6.3R must add exact artifact digest, authority, coordinate and no-fact-promotion projection

adapters.observed_behavior: Uses DuckDB read_only=True and filters ledger_facts by object id, ticker, fiscal year, form type, source tier, metric family and period role before returning hydrated rows.
adapters.permitted_future_use: M6.3R.3 only: produce a bounded SQL/TableCandidate or candidate row from one pinned immutable ledger snapshot through a receipt-bound tool route.
mandatory_downstream_validation: numeric trace or later M6.5 gate
adapters.prohibited_claim: A returned ledger row is never direct Evidence promotion, accepted evidence or Writer-citable evidence.

adapters.observed_behavior: Typed primary-SEC exact-value contract declares ticker/year/form/metric/period-role/source-tier inputs and returns ledger rows plus artifact references; it prohibits adjacent-text/model-memory inference and period-role ambiguity.
adapters.permitted_future_use: M6.3R.3 may reuse this typed boundary only after M6.2 ToolRegistry admission and a ToolInvocationReceipt bind the exact immutable ledger snapshot, request and policy.
adapters.blocking_gap: The existing contract alone does not provide Point01 ToolInvocationReceipt/admission, immutable snapshot binding, selector/numeric lineage validation or promotion authority.

adapters.observed_behavior: The registry can directly dispatch _invoke_ledger and contains relaxed filing-type/period-role fallback queries when no rows are found.
adapters.permitted_future_use: Only a future receipt-bound M6.2 tool route may wrap the typed MCP contract after separate authorization; it must prohibit relaxed-filter fallback for an exact request.
adapters.blocking_gap: Direct handler reuse would bypass ToolInvocationReceipt/admission and its fallback behavior conflicts with exact request-bound retrieval.

adapters.observed_behavior: Returns governance counts, claim/gap/gate history, source provenance and historical research context. Its shared connection helper is not an immutable read-only adapter contract.
adapters.permitted_future_use: At most future governance/history candidate context after a separately pinned read-only snapshot adapter; never issuer exact-value recall.
adapters.prohibited_claim: May not enter Evidence Gate as a numeric candidate, substitute for issuer source, override source authority or establish an exact fact.

adapters.observed_behavior: Selects reconciled, gate-passing memo-eligible facts after D6/D9/D10 governance.
adapters.permitted_future_use: None as an M6.3R retrieval adapter.
adapters.blocking_gap: It is downstream governed selection, not recall; using it to fill or rank retrieval candidates would leak selection authority backward.

adapters.permitted_future_use: only a separately built, immutable graph snapshot may later be read through a dedicated adapter
adapters.blocking_gap: module owns graph construction and SQLite/JSON write paths, so it cannot be called by a read-only M6.3R retrieval runtime

adapters.permitted_future_use: reference metadata and source-family filters only
adapters.blocking_gap: mutates broader graph state, uses environment-gated path discovery and belongs to downstream Context ownership
composes DenseRetriever and can invoke an embedding model; the current point permits zero model calls
query embedding uses model.encode and is outside the zero-model local deterministic tranche
archived outside packaged runtime and explicitly lacks current ownership
